tests.result:
CAPTAIN'S HANDBOOK
How to play
The goal

End night 30 with the largest fortune: cash + vault + half-price cargo − debt. Your rank and the Captains' Ledger are waiting.

Trading
Each district has its own prices, and they shift every night. The small line on each good is its last 10 nights here; tap a good for the full chart.
The % beside each price compares it with that good's usual price across the city. Green is cheap (buy), amber is dear (sell). Surge and Glut tags mark market shocks.
An ↑ +40% Saint Mire tag means the good last sold there for 40% more than it costs here. Without a price seen, the tag names a district that usually pays well.
Big orders move prices. Dealers trade a few units at the posted price, then each extra unit costs more (or fetches less), and the market takes a night or two to recover. Spread big money across several goods and ports.
Every district is famous for something it makes cheap and something it pays well for. Check the map card.
Voyages
Sailing along a canal costs one night; a district with no direct canal is two nights, via a waypoint. Lanternquay joins every district. You can also stay the night where you are (tap your own district on the map). The danger pips show how often patrols and gangs prowl.
The trade screen remembers the last price you saw everywhere; green +% badges on the map show where your cargo sells above cost.
Debt and the vault
Marrow Quill's 6% nightly interest snowballs. Repay at Lanternquay.
The Lockwater Vault (Lanternquay, Drowned Exchange) pays 1.5% a night and keeps cash safe.
Upgrades
Copperhook Docks: bigger hold, faster engine, repairs. Saint Mire & Fogmouth: weapons. Drowned Exchange: a wireless set for live prices everywhere. Orchid Terraces: Madame Ysolde sells one rumour a night about tomorrow's shocks. Rumours can land weak or turn the other way; she tells you how sure she is.
Danger
Patrols, the Gull Gang and Marrow's collectors may stop you. Run, fight, bribe or pay. If your hull hits 0%, you sink and lose your cash and cargo.
Sound

Every sound is synthesized live. Toggle it under More (or press M). No sound on an iPhone? Check the ring/silent switch.
